# ATP500 DHCP lease 10 minutes on every tenant pool (before step 4)
# Generated by plans/gen-fortigate-cli.py from the 13/14 Oct 2026 captures. Do not edit; re-run.
# Lines starting with # are comments for the reader; FortiOS ignores them when pasted.

# ATP500, full admin (--admin, Google Authenticator) or console. ZLD syntax: lease <days> <hours> <minutes>.
# Shortens every tenant pool to 10 minutes so stale leases die quickly after each cabinet moves.
# Same subnet and gateway on the FortiGate replica, so clients mostly keep working; this just tidies renewals.
configure terminal
# LAN_POOL (the switches' and APs' own 192.168.1.x scope) is deliberately NOT shortened: the
# FortiGate replicates that subnet on the aggregate, so management devices keep their addresses
# exactly like the tenants do.
ip dhcp pool Network_Pool_VLAN10
 lease 0 0 10
exit
